open_points.subject: Audit sequence high-water mark
open_points.text: never reused, also after old entries are erased (R0-66) or the store is restored (State 2 A15) ... A number minted for a change that did not commit is not used again
open_points.question: What durable fact preserves the greatest sequence number ever minted, including numbers from uncommitted changes, so restoring an older store cannot mint one again?
options: A separate durable sequence high-water mark is part of Registry state
The value is preserved outside the restored store
Restore supplies or reconstructs the greatest number ever minted
The guarantee applies only to numbers visible in the restored store
open_points.default_guess: Keep a separate durable sequence high-water mark and preserve it across restore.

open_points.subject: MigrationClosure across restore
open_points.text: absent, then present forever: once a backup holding it has passed its check, no backup without it is kept
open_points.question: After the import succeeds but before a checked backup containing the closure exists, may restoring an older backup remove the MigrationClosure and reopen the one-time import?
options: A backup without the closure may never be restored after import succeeds
Import is not considered successfully closed until a checked backup contains the closure
The closure is preserved separately when an older backup is restored
The closure may disappear and the import may reopen during this interval
open_points.default_guess: Once import succeeds, restoring a backup without the closure is prohibited.
